events.title: Hadrian adopts Antoninus Pius as his heir
events.description: Hadrian made Antoninus his successor on condition that he adopt Marcus Aurelius and Lucius Verus. The arrangement secured more than four decades of stable rule.
events.html: Hadrian made Antoninus his successor on condition that he adopt Marcus Aurelius and Lucius Verus. The arrangement secured more than four decades of stable rule.

events.title: Kavad II overthrows his father Khosrow II
events.description: Kavad II overthrew his father, Khosrow II, the last great king of the Sasanian Empire, after the defeat by Heraclius, and had him killed. Kavad made peace with the Byzantines but died within the year, starting a succession crisis.

events.title: Pope Pius V excommunicates Elizabeth I
events.description: The bull Regnans in Excelsis declared Elizabeth a heretic and released her subjects from obedience. English Catholics came to be seen as potential traitors, and persecution intensified.

events.title: Handel's opera Nero opens in Hamburg
events.description: George Frideric Handel's opera Nero opened in Hamburg, with Mattheson in the title role. Less successful than his Almira, it ran for only three performances before the theatre closed for Lent, and its music has not survived.

events.title: Samuel Colt patents his revolver
events.description: Colt received a US patent for a revolving-cylinder pistol. His first company failed, but orders during the Mexican-American War made Colt revolvers famous worldwide.
events.html: Colt received a US patent for a revolving-cylinder pistol. His first company failed, but orders during the Mexican-American War made Colt revolvers famous worldwide.

events.title: Hiram Revels becomes the first African American US Senator
events.description: The Mississippi minister was sworn in after a fierce debate over his eligibility. He filled the seat Jefferson Davis had left when the South seceded.
events.html: The Mississippi minister was sworn in after a fierce debate over his eligibility. He filled the seat Jefferson Davis had left when the South seceded.

events.title: Adolf Hitler acquires German citizenship
events.description: Stateless since renouncing his Austrian citizenship in 1925, Hitler was given a nominal post in the state of Brunswick, making him a German citizen. He could now stand for President.
events.html: Stateless since renouncing his Austrian citizenship in 1925, Hitler was given a nominal post in the state of Brunswick, making him a German citizen. He could now stand for President.

events.title: People Power Revolution forces Marcos from the Philippines
events.description: After days of peaceful mass protest, Ferdinand Marcos fled Manila for Hawaii and Corazon Aquino was sworn in as president. His two decades of rule had included years of martial law.
